name: PP2 Language Activities: Letter sounds a, b, c
subject: Language Activities
learningObjectives: By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to say the sounds of letters a, b and c
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to name words beginning with a, b and c
learningActivities: Sound game: teacher says a sound, learners repeat it together
Picture cards: learners name pictures and identify the beginning sound
Sound hunt: learners find classroom objects beginning with a, b or c
Rhyme: learners recite a short rhyme emphasising the sounds
keyPoints: Letter 'a' makes the sound /a/ as in 'apple'
Letter 'b' makes the sound /b/ as in 'ball'
Letter 'c' makes the sound /k/ as in 'cat'
commonMisconceptions: Confusing letter names with letter sounds
Adding a vowel sound after a consonant (saying 'buh' instead of /b/)
lessonEvaluation: Learners say the sounds of a, b, c and name words beginning with each sound. Teacher observes.
teacherReflection: Sounds were well mastered. Learners enjoyed the sound hunt activity.
